title: Ring-hand gestures
desc: Four ring-hand gestures (point to cast, fist-raise oath, ring to forehead, power-up as the ring goes on) in first and third person; J picked "ring-hand gestures".

takes.name: Point to cast
takes.facts: arm snaps straight out at 12, other hand steadies the wrist, ring flares to 14, bolt 14-24, held to 34

takes.name: Fist-raise oath
takes.facts: fist straight up by 18, head tilts up 40 deg after it, column of light 18-26, held to 44

takes.name: Ring to forehead
takes.facts: hand to the brow by 12, head bows 34 deg, face and eyes light 14-40, hand drops by 54

takes.name: Power-up as the ring goes on
takes.facts: left hand slides the ring on at 14, arms flex down and out, knees 45 deg, ring flares to 16, light ring, outline flash 20-31
